meta.name: POÇO CÓSMICO
meta.brief: Uma queda lenta por um poço de estrelas em uma tela vertical; vertigem suave, sem pressa.

contract.concept: Uma queda lenta por um poço de estrelas em uma tela vertical; vertigem suave, sem pressa.
contract.audienceEffect: O público deve sentir Uma queda lenta por um poço de estrelas em uma tela vertical; vertigem suave, sem pressa.
contract.semioticIntent: Mood cosmic: Uma queda lenta por um poço de estrelas em uma tela vertical; vertigem suave, sem pressa.
contract.visualLanguage: Generator tiers from the mood table (cosmic); one dominant figure per composition over a quiet ground.
contract.formLanguage: Forms follow the hero generator of each composition; the structure layer keeps one module and one grid.
contract.materialLanguage: Light on a dark ground: additive matter, no fake materials.
contract.colorLogic: split scheme, OKLCH hue 290 (deep violet and a cold accent); one accent used for events only.
contract.spatialLogic: Canvas 1080x1920 (screen); the hero sits on the focal zone, structure on the grid, information at the edge.
contract.motionLanguage: Profile: smooth, eased; springy (zeta 0.648, 7% overshoot); with a wind-up dip before each hit; 4 move(s) per loop of 4 bar(s), so the loop closes. Played as layer.mod spring curves (scripts/motion_profiles.py).
contract.typographyLanguage: Uppercase, one family; text only when the brief supplies exact words.
contract.temporalArc: Each composition: establish, evolve, peak, release over 4 bars; the set follows establish, build, peak.
contract.loopGrammar: cyclic: the loop closes on whole bars and every layer moves in whole cycles
contract.technicalStrategy: Generated without AI by brief_to_project.py from the structured brief; native pixels, deterministic seed, engine generators only.
contract.forbiddenShortcuts: Do not stretch 16:9 across another aspect; no unseeded randomness; no effect without a reason in the contract.
contract.focalEvent: One dominant figure per composition; everything else supports or releases it.
contract.releaseZone: The ground field and the empty third of the frame; no layer fills it.
contract.banned: shockwave rings on every hit; particle bursts; neon glow everywhere

artBible.thesis: Uma queda lenta por um poço de estrelas em uma tela vertical; vertigem suave, sem pressa.
artBible.material: Light on a dark ground (cosmic); additive matter, no fake materials, no gradients that pretend to be objects.
artBible.space: Read at arm's length: fine detail allowed, the hero on the focal third, information at the edge.
artBible.motion: Profile: smooth, eased; springy (zeta 0.648, 7% overshoot); with a wind-up dip before each hit; 4 move(s) per loop of 4 bar(s), so the loop closes. Played as layer.mod spring curves (scripts/motion_profiles.py).
artBible.dramaturgy: Each composition: establish, evolve, peak, release over 4 bars; the set follows establish, build, peak. Tension: balanced; one dominant figure per composition; the ground field is the release.
artBible.color: split scheme, OKLCH hue 290 (deep violet and a cold accent); one accent used for events only.
artBible.typography: No text unless the brief supplies exact words; if added: uppercase, one family, three sizes at most.
artBible.audio: Strategy subtle: the music only breathes the ground.
artBible.banned: shockwave rings on every hit; particle bursts; neon glow everywhere

assumed.why: generated from the brief without AI; the facts are the brief's own
assumed.risk: confirm the pixel map and distances with the venue before delivery

compositions.name: COSMIC I
compositions.hypothesis: ESTABLISH: Uma queda lenta por um poço de estrelas em uma tela vertical; vertigem suave, sem pressa.

layers.name: FUNDO
layers.role: ground colour of the piece; the quiet reference everything else is read against

layers.name: CAMPO COSMIC I
layers.role: ground field: slow matter that gives the figure something to cut against

layers.name: ATMOSFERA I
layers.role: atmosphere: a second, fainter field in the accent that adds depth without competing with the hero

layers.name: HERÓI COSMIC I
layers.role: hero: the single dominant figure of this composition (the focal event)

layers.name: ESTRUTURA I
layers.role: structure: the grid or rhythm the eye measures the hero against

layers.name: INSTRUMENTO I
layers.role: instrument: shows the real signal that drives the picture (cause and effect)

layers.name: INFORMAÇÃO I
layers.role: information: small, calm, always the same place; it tells the viewer the system is alive

layers.name: ACABAMENTO
layers.role: finish: vignette and a touch of tension; scanlines only where the surface is a screen
